sentences.text: If you lay a flat board on four posts, you have a roof.
But rain pools on top and drips through onto you.
So you tilt the board into two slopes, and the rain runs off.
But now it pours off the edge and splashes mud everywhere.
So a gutter along the edge feeds a downspout that carries it down.
But now rain still seeps through the gaps between the boards.
So you lay shingles from the bottom up, each row overlapping the one below.
One inch of rain on a 1,000 square foot roof is over 600 gallons.
Add a ridge cap and a chimney.
Congratulations, you have built a roof.
